newsitem.title: CHINA: China capital Beijing rocked by bus bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: China capital Beijing rocked by bus bomb blast.

text.p: BEIJING, March 7 ( Reuter) - At least two people were killed and several were injured in at least one bomb attack on a bus in China's capital Beijing during Friday's rush hour, Chinese sources said.
The explosion occurred in Beijing's western shopping district of Xidan, the sources said.
The motive of the bombing was not immediately clear and it was not immediately known if police had made any arrests.

On February 25, in the restive Moslem region of Xinjiang, three bombs planted on buses blew up within minutes of each other in an apparently coordinated attack that coincided with funeral rites in Beijing for paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
A pro-Beijing newspaper said on Friday that China had arrested seven suspects in the Xinjiang attacks that killed nine people and wounded 74 in the northwestern region.
